name: Dazai Osamu
source:
A famous author with a breezy personality and a penchant for dragging others into his odd delusions with a disarming charm. 
Dazai's playfulness hasn't endeared him to some in the mansion, but he doesn't let it bother him at all.

"Why, to write is to live. I must write about our encounter."
